subject.title: fix(agent): classify stuck recovery as idle timeout

question: Should this PR's phase-aware stuck-recovery classification become the supported replay boundary for diagnostic recovery?
rationale: The code matches the maintainer-requested shape, but deciding that active model-call stalls may use idle-timeout fallback while side-effecting tool stalls may not is an agent/session replay-policy choice.

options.title: Accept phase-aware boundary
options.body: Land after owner review with the current model-call versus side-effecting-tool distinction as the supported recovery behavior.

options.title: Require broader recovery proof
options.body: Keep this PR open until broader runtime proof covers more model-call and tool-call recovery paths against the latest main.

options.title: Pause for recovery timing
options.body: Hold this PR if https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98580 becomes the canonical fix for the same stuck-session path.

recommendation.title: Accept phase-aware boundary
